data.name: Randheer
data.gender_notes: Randheer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Randheer is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘rādhā-dhīr’ meaning ‘one who is ruled by Radha’. Radha is the consort of Lord Krishna and is considered the epitome of love and devotion. The name Randheer signifies someone who is ruled by love, and is therefore, a courageous, handsome and brave individual. The name Randheer carries the meaning “Ruler of the Thunderbolt” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Randheer usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the thunderbolt and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and courage to rule over one's emotions and desires, just like Lord Krishna rules over the universe.
data.etymology: Randheer belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Thunderbolt.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Randheer total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
